title: resasm residual request contract (v1)
description: The high-level OUTPUT-PARAMETER request the collaborator writes: every output field is paired with its OWN material parameters (with_respect_to), a single scope selects the domain and increments, and the material is the OTI object (its completed contract is the sibling .json). Consumed by residual_core.replay.request_contract.run_request_contract. The low-level per-point form (parameters + node/element outputs) is an internal expansion used by residual_core.replay.engine.run_request.

material.description: path to the OTI object (.obj); the completed contract is the sibling .json

model.description: path to the FE model (.inp); optional, the record already carries the mesh

record.description: path to the converged replay record

domain.description: 'ALL' or the name of a node/element set defined in the record

requests.description: pair every output with its own set of material parameters

output.description: U (displacement), RF (reaction), S (stress), or a state-variable name such as EQPLAS

with_respect_to.description: material parameters to differentiate THIS output against (each must exist in the material contract)

output_dir.description: where to write the sensitivity results (default sensitivity_out)
